title: Microsoft Teams: customise the recording and transcription notification and consent text
summary: Hold: the summary incorrectly places the privacy policy link under individual meeting policies; Microsoft documents it as a tenant-wide meeting setting. The briefing also describes the later calls feature as the same meeting capability in more clouds. The documented paths and command names check out, and the warning about the unfinished PowerShell route is justified.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes custom messages and privacy links for implicit notification or explicit consent during meeting recording and transcription.
claims.quote: IT admins can customize the message and privacy link used to notify implicitly or gain explicit consent from meeting participants for the use of recording, transcription during the meeting.

claims.claim: The privacy policy link can be replaced per meeting policy.
claims.quote: The Teams admin center through Meeting settings > Email invitation > Privacy and Security URL.
claims.fix: Replace the summary's first sentence with: 'Teams admins can customise recording and transcription messages per meeting policy and set the privacy policy link tenant-wide.' The tenant-wide setting is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/meeting-recording#set-a-custom-privacy-policy-url and https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/set-csteamsmeetingconfiguration?view=teams-ps.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The toggle is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Show customized in-meeting notification for recording and transcription.
claims.quote: Navigate to Meetings → Meeting policies. Select or create a meeting policy where you want to enable custom messages. In the Recording & transcription section, find the new setting: Show customized in-meeting notification for recording and transcription.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -EnableRecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessage $true is the documented custom-message toggle call, subject to the page's PowerShell warning.
claims.quote: This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect. This policy controls whether custom strings can be shown for recording and transcription in user's Teams meetings. It need to work with RecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessageIdentifier.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Custom text is configured at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Customize notification.
claims.quote: In the Recording & transcription section, find the new setting: Show customized in-meeting notification for recording and transcription. Use the toggle to enable or disable custom messages for this policy. Click the Customize notification button to set your custom message.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -RecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessageIdentifier <Guid> assigns the custom message identifier, subject to the stated no-effect warning.
claims.quote: This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect. This attribute holds the unique identifier for the custom recording and transcription meeting message. It stores a GUID that points to the CustomMessage in TeamsCustomMessageConfiguration.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The privacy URL field is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting settings > Email invitation > Privacy and security URL.
claims.quote: In the left navigation, expand Meetings > Meeting settings. Under Email invitation, do the following: Privacy and security URL If your organization has a legal website that you want people to go to for any legal concerns, enter the URL here.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -LegalURL <String> sets the privacy URL.
claims.quote: -LegalURL: URL to a website containing legal information and meeting disclaimers. This would be included in the meeting invite. Please ensure this URL is publicly accessible for invites that go beyond your federation boundaries

claims.claim: Explicit consent is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting Policies > policy > Recording & Transcription > Require participant agreement for recording and transcription.
claims.quote: Under Meetings, select Meeting Policies. Either select an existing policy or create a new one. Within your chosen policy, navigate to the Recording & Transcription section. Toggle the Require participant agreement for recording and transcription setting On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -ExplicitRecordingConsent Enabled requires explicit recording and transcription consent.
claims.quote: To require participants to give their explicit consent to be recorded or transcribed in any meeting that organizers with this policy create, run the following command: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -ExplicitRecordingConsent Enabled

claims.quote: Searched: Teams recording transcription custom message audit changes policy permissions data access. Read custom-message feature and meeting-recording; results describe message/URL customisation and existing recording storage, not new data access by the message setting.

claims.claim: No change to permissions or sign-in is documented for custom notification messages.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The custom notification setting does not start, stop or block recording or transcription, or change what is recorded or who can record.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams recording transcription custom message audit changes policy permissions data access. Read custom-message feature and meeting-recording: they describe message customisation and separate recording permission controls, but do not expressly state this exhaustive no-effect claim.
claims.fix: Replace 'No change: the setting does not start, stop or block recording or transcription' with 'The documented setting customises notification text and its privacy policy link.' Remove ', not what is recorded or transcribed' from Data exposure. Replace the risk rationale with: 'Low. The documented setting customises recording-notice wording and the privacy policy link; the risk is a misleading or broken message reaching every participant in affected meetings.'

claims.claim: Entering <empty> for a language or scenario leaves only the fixed notification information.
claims.quote: If you don’t want to display any message (excluding the fixed information), you can insert <empty> for the specific language or scenario. In this case, the notification shows only the fixed information.

claims.claim: Excel uses a different default CSV delimiter in some non-English system languages.
claims.quote: In some non-English system languages (for example, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, and other European locales), Excel uses a different default CSV delimiter based on regional settings.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance

claims.quote: To avoid formatting issues, admins using these system languages should edit the CSV template using another plain text editor. Please do not edit or re-save the CSV file using Excel.

The attendance-report route is conditional on the report being enabled and participants being included, as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/participant-agreement-recording-transcription.
